meta.description: Every CPU and GPU seen in a Blender benchmark, a retail price, a SPEC CPU 2017 result or a SPEC GWPG disclosure, with the pages that show it and why it is or is not ranked on the over- and under-performer page.

sources.name: SPEC CPU 2017 published results
sources.licence: SPEC Fair Use Rules (https://www.spec.org/products/fairuse). Public use is allowed when the source and retrieval date are stated, the licensee of each result is identifiable, the SPEC trademarks are acknowledged, SPEC metrics are compared only with SPEC metrics of the same benchmark release, and derived values and estimates are clearly labelled and never called SPEC metrics. The site does all of these.
sources.frequency: weekly collection; SPEC publishes new results about every two weeks
sources.typical_lag: results appear weeks to months after the test date

sources.name: SPEC Graphics and Workstation Performance Group (GWPG) published results
sources.licence: SPEC Fair Use Rules (https://www.spec.org/products/fairuse). Public use is allowed when the source and retrieval date are stated, the licensee of each result is identifiable, the SPEC, SPECviewperf, SPECworkstation and SPECapc trademarks are acknowledged, SPEC metrics are compared only within the same benchmark release and resolution, and derived values and estimates are clearly labelled and never called SPEC metrics. The site does all of these.
sources.frequency: weekly collection; SPEC/GWPG publishes new workstation and GPU results periodically
sources.typical_lag: results appear weeks to months after the test date

sources.name: Blender Open Data benchmark snapshots
sources.licence: CC0 (Creative Commons Zero), stated on https://opendata.blender.org/download/ and in the LICENSE.txt shipped in each snapshot. No conditions on reuse; the site credits it anyway.
sources.frequency: weekly collection; snapshots are regenerated daily

finding.reason: Coverage as collected: which products have which measurements.
